disclaimer: Checks backtest methodology (look-ahead, costs, selection bias), not future profit. Not investment advice: a research example, not a call to trade or a promise of profit. Simulated results do not predict future returns.
next_actions: Sharpe does not survive the number of variants tried: test out-of-sample or reduce the search space.

The profit comes from market exposure, not timing: shifted copies of the same positions earn as much. Compare with buy-and-hold at the same exposure, or find a signal that beats its own shifted copies.
The return is not shown to be more than benchmark exposure: add a hedge against the benchmark (long-short, market-neutral) or test where the benchmark fell; do not call it alpha.
The evidence comes from one market regime: extend the history to include falling and volatile markets, or add assets that were in other regimes, before trusting it.
Modeled costs are below the real spread: re-run with slippage at least the measured half-spread (quotes_half_spread_bps) and the exchange fee tier (cost_profile).
